dropzone.text: Drop a PDF or an image here
recents.title: Recent
contract.title: Contract
contract.addFieldHint: Create an empty field to define it by hand.
contract.addFieldBlockHint: Create a field using the selected block as a label.
contract.extractHint: Find values using the assigned labels, without an LLM.
contract.homologateHint: Save the layout (labels and columns) for documents of the same type. Values are not saved.
contract.exportSchemaHint: Download the annotated JSON Schema used by the CLI.
contract.exportTextHint: Download the OCR text as Markdown.
contract.help1: Select a text block in the document: it is highlighted on the page and in the list.
contract.help2: Add a field or create one from the block. Labels are the text next to the value in the document.
contract.help3: If the value is in a table, choose the column (units, amount, earned, …).
contract.help4: «Test extraction» finds values without an LLM. «Save template» stores the layout for identical documents.
contract.empty: Add a field to start. If you select a block, «Field from block» uses it as a label.
field.noSelection: No block selected. Click a box or a text line.
field.name: name
field.nameHint: JSON identifier, no spaces. Example: base_salary.
field.labelsHint: Text next to the value. Use «Assign block» to add it from the selection.
field.sourceHint: Only if the value is in a column: units, amount, earned, to deduct…
field.assignHint: Select a block in the document first.
error.invalidName: invalid name: use letters, digits and underscore, not starting with a digit
confirm.delete: Delete this workspace and its files?
contract.addListHint: Declare a list of items once; roles apply to every row.
contract.helpLists: For lists (tickets): add a «list» and map the roles once; you do not select each item.
list.title: Repeated list
list.rolesHint: Give each role a property name. Text and amount are required; quantity and observation are optional.
list.startHint: Where the list starts. Empty: first item row.
list.stopHint: TOTAL, TAX, SUBTOTAL… Without them, the list may swallow totals.
list.stopWarning: Without stop labels, the list may swallow totals.
error.listRequiredRole: the list needs the «{role}» role with a property name
error.listEmpty: the list needs at least the text and amount roles
list.nameHint: Array name in the JSON, no spaces. Example: order.
